findings.title: A valid positive quote can underflow to a zero midpoint and terminate evaluation
findings.evidence: snapshot accepts bid=ask=5e-324 as positive finite floats, but bid / 2 + ask / 2 evaluates to zero. Bars retains that price. A horizon pair using that sample reaches math.log(0) in evaluate without a catch.
findings.impact: A malformed numeric source quote can stop the continuous paper forecast worker and leave retained output. This does not submit orders.
findings.fix: Validate the computed midpoint as finite and strictly positive before admitting it, or use a stable midpoint calculation with the same positive/finite postcondition. Keep the current projection formula and policies.
findings.counterexample_sketch: With now=t=observed=100 and q[SOL-USD]=[5e-324,5e-324,0,0,0,100], require snapshot to emit no zero-price quote. A warmed Worker must survive this input without persisting it.
findings.verification: Static arithmetic/control-flow counterexample; no test executed by this agent. Root owns the regression test.

findings.title: Two independent freshness windows admit observations twice as old as MAX_AGE
findings.evidence: For now=100, raw.t=85, and quote.observed=70, both now-stamp<=15 and stamp-observed<=15 hold. snapshot therefore admits an observation 30 seconds old. report separately rejects observed age above15.
findings.impact: The immediate old frame is correctly retained, so this is not a proven falsely fresh display. However a warmed Worker still inserts the old midpoint into Bars and issues calls at100 with target110 against an entry observed at70. A timely observation at110 can then credit an old-entry comparison as a prospective10-second hit or miss, affecting later genuinely fresh rankings.
findings.fix: Also enforce 0 <= now-observed <= MAX_AGE before admitting the quote. Bootstrap continues to pass stamp as now, so its historical per-record freshness semantics remain unchanged. Consider the same absolute-age invariant at issuance if evaluation can be delayed.
findings.counterexample_sketch: Require snapshot to reject now=100,t=85,observed=70. With warmed bars, ensure rejected input creates no calls; a later valid observation recovers normally. Retain existing frame rather than erase it.
findings.verification: Static value and control-flow trace only; no tests executed.

findings.title: Recorder read and decode failures have no actionable diagnostic
findings.evidence: sample catches OSError and ValueError and assigns quotes={}, and oversized input takes the same empty path. There is no logger or diagnostic state in this file. run continues to loop. report exposes only generic awaiting/retained reasons.
findings.impact: A missing, permission-denied, malformed, or oversized latest.json leaves the worker running with retained forecasts while concealing the cause needed to repair the feed. This is an observability gap, not an order-safety issue.
findings.fix: Emit sanitized reason-coded, rate-limited or transition-only warnings for read/decode/size failures and a recovery event. Preserve fail-closed quote rejection and retained output. Do not log raw recorder bodies, prices payloads, or exception text that could expose source content.
findings.counterexample_sketch: Corrupt latest.json and separately deny/open-fail the source; verify one bounded safe diagnostic per transition and recovery when valid data returns, with no raw input in emitted messages.
findings.verification: Static catch/control-flow review only. Existing log assertion coverage is root-owned and not attested here.
